gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-lexend-tera: Thick, curled, nearly shut: Plakkaat's terminals sweep round toward the stem, while Lexend Tera draws open curves with one plotter-pen line. Its stepping-stone spacing keeps long paragraphs moving at a leisurely walk.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta lays tall, ribbon-like letters out at generously wide tracking. Lexend Zetta sits beneath Plakkaat's heavy bent-straw capitals, its open curves facing terminals that almost touch the stem.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-montserrat-altern: Contemporary through and through, Montserrat Alternates keeps a c as open as a bent paperclip beneath Plakkaat's heavy, nearly closed letterforms. Closed against open is the whole story here.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code draws a wire-like monoline skeleton with smooth, unobstructed bends. Its wide gaps echo Quantum's loose letterfit, so the shared quality here is breathing space.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-cascadia-mono: Modern and compact, Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a wide board, with capitals blending into lowercase beneath Quantum. Paragraphs would march along in orderly rows, each curve weighted like a stem.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-julius-sans-one: Loose, spacious letterfit defines Quantum, and its compressed ascenders stay short. Julius Sans One then stretches big blank gaps between its letters, with curves that stay open-ended.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa keeps one thickness in every direction, a big x-height, and stubby ascenders and descenders. Lexend Exa gives Quantum's loose, spaced-out headings a sturdy partner, with open curves that stay distinct.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga lays flat, single-weight linework with generous tracking that opens each word, under Quantum's loose, compressed-ascender display letters. Paragraphs would glide along steadily in flat, widely spaced lines.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-lexend-mega: One nib, one friendly line, drawn by Lexend Mega. Beneath Quantum's loose, tech-clean headings, Lexend Mega's body height nearly matches the capitals, and each c shows a visible gap.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-lexend-peta: Quantum sets loose, tech-clean display letters with open mouths, while Lexend Peta brings a big x-height and wide, unthinned curves. Paragraphs in this sans-serif body would move at a broad, comfortable stride.
